verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a dedicated Extract endpoint that pulls web page content from one URL or a batch of up to 20 URLs, with per-URL failure reporting. It is also exposed in the SDKs, CLI (`tvly extract`), keyless mode and MCP, and Crawl adds built-in extraction across many pages. That covers retrieving page content beyond search snippets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the output is full raw text or markdown (no format option shown), an evidenced option to include full content directly in search results, and independent hands-on corroboration.
